_notes: Copy to lead-inputs.json and fill the empty values. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
An empty value leaves its pins TO-PIN with a reason; nothing is guessed.
keys.ubuntu and keys.ubuntu-release are built into the resolver with their citations; give them here only to replace them.
keys.nvidia and keys.tailscale: full 40-hex fingerprints from a source you checked yourself, with that source named.
production_converter.revision: a 40-hex git commit id for a git checkout, or the git tree id of the reviewed export without .git (git add -A && git write-tree in an initialised scratch copy).

tei_drop.spark121: release specification section 15 item 24 (lead design call, 2026-11-14): the DGX Spark embeddings class (spark121, an ARM machine) is dropped from the amd64 GPU disc
